notes: Box score from the Trail Blazers' 128–111 win at Philadelphia on Nov 23, 2026, from the Covers box score; all 128 Portland points and all 111 Philadelphia points add up from the player lines, and the shooting totals (46 of 90, 19 of 42 from three, 17 of 26 FT for Portland; 41 of 87, 9 of 33, 20 of 24 for Philadelphia), rebounds (49–33), assists (32–25), blocks (6–4), steals (5–7), fast-break points (7–14) and the biggest leads (Portland 22, Philadelphia 8) are from Covers. The 19-of-42 three-point shooting is also in Field Level Media and the Philadelphia Inquirer, and the 76ers' 9 of 33 is in the AP. The quarter scores (30–39–32–27 to 32–37–23–19) add up to both totals; the 69–69 halftime tie is also in Field Level Media and Fastbreak Journal, and the 101–92 score after three in the AP and Field Level Media. Player lines used here match the stories (Avdija 31 with 25 in the first half, Clingan 15 points and 18 rebounds, Henderson 17, all after halftime; James 23, Maxey 22, Brown 20 with 19 in the first half). Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Monday's games.

Portland ended Philadelphia's five-game winning streak (AP; Field Level Media; Philadelphia Inquirer) and finished its six-game road trip 3–3 (AP). LeBron James's 23 points were his most in a game in his first season with the 76ers (AP). Joel Embiid did not play (illness), and Jaylen Brown returned from a two-game absence with a hamstring injury (AP; Field Level Media). Next: Portland hosts San Antonio on Wednesday (Fastbreak Journal; Covers schedule), the 76ers host Miami on Wednesday (AP; Philadelphia Inquirer).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Scoot Henderson's 3-pointer with 6:36 left: Field Level Media: "Henderson's 3-pointer with 6:36 left made it an 18-point game, and then Robert Williams' putback created a 20-point spread." The board's Blazers +15 to +18 follows from the three. The shot isn't described further, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up from beyond the arc. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Portland Trail Blazers or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Henderson's listed 6-foot-3 and 207 pounds (Basketball-Reference, Wikipedia), with arms at the default length because neither source reports a wingspan, in the Trail Blazers' road kit with No. 00 (Basketball-Reference, Wikipedia) and the default darker skin tone, since he has no approved look yet. It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
